statement.zh: 将肖图盖解释为印度河「殖民点/贸易站」并为青金石等资源而设——属长期学术模型，非档案定论。
statement.en: Reading Shortughaï as an Indus ‘colony/trading post’ founded for resources such as lapis remains a long-standing scholarly model, not an archival verdict.

disclaimer: HYPOTHESIS — colony/trading-post functional labels are interpretive; fact column records excavated Harappan-related material only.
